en.headline: 22 own commits across three repositories and activity on issue #8
en.summary: There were **22** own commits across three repositories, plus **26** automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, 13 own commits documented DeepSeek reasoning_effort usage, added and removed temporary CI probes, changed the MiniMax free path to `reasoning_effort=low`, and updated the codemap baseline to `d93ea4d`. In `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate`, six own commits established an MV3 translation skeleton, removed selection translation, reset page state between runs, added DOM smoke tests and required-field validation, enabled JSDoc checking, and added `AGENTS.md`. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, three own commits expanded knowledge documentation for OMO slim v3.0.5 skills and `openchamber-storage`. The issues total was **1**; in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` issue #8, “[ai-failure] AI 叙述生成失败,” `sogeisetsu` commented on a thread containing 5 comments. Separately, `btriapitsyn` closed `openchamber/openchamber` issue #5293, “[Bug] Project actions menu: Auto-discover dev server runs the first saved action instead of discovering a server”; there were 0 pull requests and 0 reviews.

zh.headline: 三个仓库共 22 次本人提交，并在 issue #8 留下活动
zh.summary: 三个仓库共有 **22** 次本人提交，另有 **26** 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 的 13 次本人提交记录了 DeepSeek `reasoning_effort` 用量，添加并删除临时 CI 探针，将 MiniMax 免费路径改为 `reasoning_effort=low`，并把 codemap 基线更新到 `d93ea4d`。`sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` 的 6 次本人提交建立 MV3 翻译骨架，移除选区翻译，在翻译运行间重置页面状态，加入 DOM 冒烟测试和必填字段校验，启用 JSDoc 检查并添加 `AGENTS.md`。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 的 3 次本人提交扩充了 OMO slim v3.0.5 skill 与 `openchamber-storage` 的知识文档。issue 总数为 **1**；`sogeisetsu` 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 的 issue #8“[ai-failure] AI 叙述生成失败”中参与了评论，该讨论共有 5 条评论。另有 `btriapitsyn` 关闭了 `openchamber/openchamber` 的 issue #5293“[Bug] Project actions menu: Auto-discover dev server runs the first saved action instead of discovering a server”；当天共有 0 个 pull request 和 0 次 review。
